message:
Now I understand the fuzzer. The first 6 bytes are config bytes (color format at offset 6, num cores at offset 7, arch at offset 8), and the rest is the H.264/MVC bitstream. The fuzzer first calls `decodeHeader` which processes the bitstream to get SPS/PPS, then calls `decodeFrame` repeatedly.

Now I need to understand how the MVC decoder processes SEI NAL units. Let me look at the main API function:

<｜｜DSML｜｜>
<parameter=command>grep -rn "NAL_UNIT_SEI\|SEI_NAL\|SEI" /workspace/repo-vul/src-vul/libavc/decoder/mvc/imvcd_api.c | head -30</｜｜DSML｜｜>
</｜｜DSML｜｜>
